name: Aberystwyth Foodbank
lng: Trussell Trust foodbank serving Capel Bangor
short_description: Nearest foodbank at Aberystwyth University Campus. Open Mon 10am-2pm and Thu 2pm-5pm. Referral required via local agencies including Ceredigion Council.

name: Ceredigion County Council Allotments
short_description: Allotment sites in Ceredigion including Capel Bangor
description: Ceredigion Council manages sites at Penparcau and Llanbadarn. Small plots available from £20/year. Contact for Capel Bangor specific availability.

name: Capel Bangor Community Growing Group
short_description: Small community garden with shared produce
description: Local volunteer group maintaining a small growing space behind Capel Bangor Chapel. Surplus vegetables shared with elderly residents. Meets Saturday mornings.
